catalysts.title: Australian Strategic Materials acquisition implementation
catalysts.description: The court-approved schemes for Energy Fuels to acquire Australian Strategic Materials are scheduled for implementation. Cash consideration is payable and new Energy Fuels shares are scheduled to begin trading on NYSE American and TSX on August 28.

catalysts.title: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launch
catalysts.description: NASA and SpaceX are targeting liftoff of the Roman Space Telescope no earlier than 7:26 a.m. EDT aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy from Kennedy Space Center.

catalysts.title: VMware Explore 2026
catalysts.description: Broadcom’s VMware Explore runs August 31–September 3 in Las Vegas, with more than 400 technical sessions, labs and certifications plus a plenary keynote featuring Broadcom executives and VMware innovations. Programming begins August 31 at 9:00 a.m. PDT.

catalysts.title: Electron launch: Owl Around The World
catalysts.description: Rocket Lab schedules its 94th Electron mission no earlier than August 31, with a 12:00 UTC (8:00 a.m. EDT) launch time from Launch Complex 1. The mission will deploy one Synspective StriX synthetic-aperture-radar satellite into a 575 km orbit.
